name: DMRadio
summary: DMRadio is a series of low-mass axion and dark-photon searches using lumped-element circuits to complement conventional microwave cavities at lower frequencies.
detection_principle: Axions excite alternating current in a magnetic field; a cryogenic high-Q LC circuit enhances the signal for SQUID readout.

key_parameters.name: DMRadio-50L
key_parameters.value: 5 kHz–5 MHz design band; cryogenic system designed to cool an approximately 200 kg load to 50 mK

phases.name: 50L
phases.description: Low-frequency axion searches and quantum-sensing tests.

phases.name: m3
phases.description: Subsequent instrument targeting higher frequencies and QCD-axion sensitivity.

results.summary: The 2026 technical paper reports the cryogenic system's design and measured performance, rather than a full dark-matter-search result.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
